negative_control.candidate: naive deep Upper-only root-space flattening without paired endpoint/nonterminal dual information
negative_control.structural_reason: Internal early-terminal branches require nonterminal/complement guards. Pure success-upset propagation that discards the dual/prefix-information state is insufficient under deeper nesting.

theorem_candidate.representation: A six-valued partial WDL function is exactly a pair of isotone endpoint maps lower,upper into the 3-chain LOSS<DRAW<WIN with lower<=upper. Each endpoint map is exactly determined by its two nested threshold upsets, hence four nested fronts.
theorem_candidate.even_block: For an even-depth alternating block, the scalar block value is monotone in all frontier values, so lower and upper endpoint maps transform independently through the same monotone predicate transformer.
theorem_candidate.odd_block: For an odd-depth block, global polarity reverses; lower and upper endpoint roles swap under negation. A one-ply endpoint transformer plus even two-ply blocks therefore closes arbitrary finite depth.
theorem_candidate.symbolic_closure: Preimages of threshold upsets under the exact q/cofactor maps are upward closed; current-player choice is union and opponent choice is intersection. Therefore the four-front carrier is closed under Bellman block composition.
theorem_candidate.action_recovery: Retaining the corresponding four fronts per root action preserves exact partial action values and therefore supports exact best-move recovery after refinement resolves.

interpretation: Six independent symbolic value regions are unnecessary; four nested monotone fronts suffice.
The four-front representation is compositionally closed through tested 2/4/6-ply blocks on arbitrary monotone q-dependent partial information.
Symbolic block composition itself is no longer the primary unknown.
The remaining compactness question is whether a composition of front transformers can be fused/factored into a small normal form without explicitly materializing intermediate support/fiber frontiers.
